summary.hypothesis: Remaining-budget hypothesis: future-aware value control will improve exact recovery of held-out, multi-step reachable molecular targets relative to myopic control, with the advantage expected to increase with transformation horizon.
summary.verdict: LOOKAHEAD AHEAD -- 17 vs 12 exact recoveries; future value has something to buy on reachable targets

per_pair.cost_caveat: Greedy runs first and its enumerations are cached, so the lookahead arm reuses them. Its marginal cost is honest; its standalone cost would be higher. Compare arms on marginal calls, not on a ratio.
